name: Tampines
summary: Mature east-region town with malls, parks, and MRT density — a heartland alternative when East Coast rents feel excessive.
body: Tampines is one of Singapore’s most complete new towns: town centre retail, strong bus/MRT links (including Downtown and East-West interchanges nearby), parks, and a predominantly local residential fabric. Expats shortlist it when they want more space per dollar than Marine Parade condos, accept a longer CBD hop, and are willing to build social life outside lobby WhatsApp groups. Housing is HDB-heavy with suburban condo pockets; verify HDB rental eligibility before you fall in love with a specific block. Weekends skew toward Tampines Mall / Century Square / Our Tampines Hub rather than Holland V brunch culture — which is either the point or the deal-breaker.
watchOuts: CBD commute longer than East Coast proper
housingMix: Predominantly HDB with suburban condo options near town centre and park connectors.
commuteNotes: Tampines MRT (EWL) and Tampines West/East (DTL); buses across the east region.
